correctness.rationale: The factorization criterion is proved in both directions for every division ring and every integer n at least 2. The necessary bound follows from im(B) contained in ker(A), rank-nullity, and rank(ARB) at most min(rank(A),rank(B)). The sufficient direction gives explicit matrix units A_r, R_r, B_r with A_r B_r=0 and A_r R_r B_r=J_r, then transports the factorization by invertible row and column changes. The finite-field count uses the exact rank-r matrix formula only after the structural theorem fixes the admissible ranks.
